Sunday Shop Ride (Bethesda Bike & Ski)

Bethesda, MD · Road

Sunday Shop Ride (Bethesda Bike & Ski) is a road group ride in Bethesda, MD. It rolls every Sunday at 9:00 am from Bethesda Bike & Ski. About 28 miles, ~15 mph average.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Shop Ride (Bethesda Bike & Ski) group ride

A 28-mile loop from the shop at a steady 15 mph with a coffee stop at Colada's in Cabin John. Rides start and end at the shop. Email the shop to get added to the WhatsApp group.
